name: MoveEmailToFolder
description: Moves a specified email message to a target folder in a Microsoft 365 Outlook mailbox using Microsoft Graph API.
author: rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Outlook Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and access mailbox data through Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: Mailbox address containing the email. Leave empty to use the authenticated user's mailbox.

fields.name: MessageId
fields.label: Message ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the email message to move.

fields.name: FolderId
fields.label: Target Folder ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the folder to move the email into.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the result of the move operation, including the new folder location of the email.
